applications.manifest:
# How Pods (https://github.com/foxws/pods) offers and installs this application.
version: 1
name: jellyfin
label: Jellyfin
description: Media server for your films, series and music
author: francoism90
icon: i-lucide-clapperboard
category: Media
website: https://jellyfin.org
repository: https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin
notes: Binds ~/Media from the host (change Device= in jellyfin-media.volume; the directory must exist) and uses the GPU at /dev/dri. Listens on 127.0.0.1:8096.

# How Pods (https://github.com/foxws/pods) offers and installs this application.
version: 1
name: mariadb
label: MariaDB
description: Relational database compatible with MySQL, version 11.8 LTS
author: foxws
icon: i-lucide-database
category: Databases
website: https://mariadb.org
repository: https://github.com/MariaDB/server
notes: Other applications reach it as mariadb on the systemd-mariadb network. The development source also listens on 127.0.0.1:3306.

sources:
  production:
    path: production
    description: Root password from a secret, reachable only on its network
  development:
    path: development
    description: Root without a password, listening on 127.0.0.1:3306

secrets:
  mariadb-root-password:
    description: Password of the MariaDB root user
    generate: true
